shortBulletSummary: US-Iran peace deal lifts global financial markets and boosts risk-on sentiment, benefiting cryptocurrencies.
Bitcoin rebounds over $66K and Ethereum breaks above $1,700, showing strong gains amid renewed buying interest.
The Federal Reserve's upcoming FOMC meeting and dot plot projections are expected to heavily influence crypto liquidity and direction.
The Crypto Fear & Greed Index remains at 23, indicating underlying investor sentiment is still stuck in 'Extreme Fear' despite recent rallies.
MicroStrategy (Strategy) continues its accumulation trend, purchasing an additional 1,587 BTC for $100 million.
